mealPrepTips.title: Sunday Prep Day
mealPrepTips.description: Dedicate 2-3 hours on Sunday to prep for the week
tips: Boil eggs for the week (store in refrigerator)
Wash and chop all vegetables
Cook a large batch of rice/quinoa
Marinate chicken portions for the week
Prepare overnight oats portions
Soak almonds and walnuts for the week

mealPrepTips.title: Protein Prep
tips: Grill or bake chicken breasts in bulk
Season with different spices for variety
Portion into daily containers (150-200 gms each)
Store in airtight containers
Can be reheated or eaten cold in salads
Make bone broth on weekends

mealPrepTips.title: Salad Station
mealPrepTips.description: Keep a salad station ready in your fridge
tips: Wash and dry greens, store in paper towel-lined container
Pre-cut vegetables in separate containers
Keep dressings (olive oil, ACV, lime) ready
Assemble fresh each day for best results
Store cucumbers separately to avoid sogginess

mealPrepTips.title: Snack Prep
tips: Portion cheese (30-40 gms) in small containers
Keep olives ready in small servings
Mix protein powder portions in bags
Pre-portion nuts and seeds
Cut fruits in morning for day's consumption

mealPrepTips.title: Morning Routine Setup
mealPrepTips.description: Prepare your morning routine the night before
tips: Soak almonds and walnuts overnight
Set up coffee maker
Pre-slice bread for avocado toast
Keep eggs accessible
Prepare protein shake ingredients

mealPrepTips.title: Storage Tips
tips: Use glass containers for meal storage
Label containers with dates
Cooked chicken lasts 3-4 days refrigerated
Freeze extra portions for busy days
Keep avocados at room temperature until ripe
